headline: Colombia Congress Approves $3.8 Trillion Budget Addition for Earthquake Reconstruction
summary: Colombia's Congress approved a budget addition of $3.8 trillion, with $2.7 billion dedicated to funding the reconstruction of areas affected by the earthquake alongside social programs.
why: Legislative budget reallocations for disaster recovery impact sovereign debt issuance and public sector capital expenditures.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Emergency budget additions alter national fiscal spending targets.
